summary: Fix-verification pass for DAVISPORN. Both previously reported HIGH bugs are RESOLVED and no regressions detected. (1) Age gate: after clicking [data-testid=age-confirm], localStorage.getItem('davisporn_age_ok')='1', #age-gate has hidden attribute and computed display:none (CSS #age-gate[hidden]{display:none !important} works). Navigating to /videos does NOT re-show the modal (hidden=True, ls='1') and [data-testid=apply-filters] is clickable. (2) /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt now emit the public preview host via X-Forwarded-Host/Proto (verified https://52ac42f2-...preview.emergentagent.com/... in <loc> and Sitemap:). Regression: home renders hero, Featured, Popular categories, Most viewed, Newest, Trending tags. /api/suggest returns 4 items for 'mo'. Filters (sort, quality, source) on /videos render the grid server-side with 24 cards. Video detail page renders player placeholder, stats, description, related. Admin behind Basic auth admin/admin123 returns 200 with Dashboard/Sources/Videos; POST /admin/cache/clear and /admin/source/import return 302. Legal pages /terms /privacy /dmca /2257 render 200 with expected headings.
critical_code_review_comments: Video detail page shows a title mismatch vs slug/description on the sampled entry (slug='kinky-nurse-enjoys-backyard-fun-0bdebb', description begins 'Kinky Nurse enjoys backyard fun', but rendered <h1>='Naughty Blonde loses control after party'). Likely seeded-data quirk in demo adapter (title picked from random pool independent of slug); non-blocking but worth aligning for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both HIGH bugs from iteration_1 verified fixed. Preview host resolved via X-Forwarded-Host (FastAPI proxy + Node proxy both forward it; SeoController reads it). Age-gate JS in /app/php/public/assets/app.js writes/reads localStorage key 'davisporn_age_ok' and CSS enforces display:none for [hidden].
rca of the issue: Iter1 age gate bug: overlay div stayed pointer-active because display was not forced to none when [hidden]; JS did not persist to expected key. Fixed by CSS rule #age-gate[hidden]{display:none !important} and JS localStorage.setItem('davisporn_age_ok','1'). Iter1 sitemap bug: SeoController used server host (127.0.0.1:9000 from PHP built-in). Fixed by preferring HTTP_X_FORWARDED_HOST/HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO, injected by FastAPI + Node proxies.
